adopted_molecular_H2.role: Existing M2 source, not a newly validated BSE law
adopted_molecular_H2.temperature_dependence: Uncalibrated; the adopted lnK has no T dependence.

adopted_metal_H.note: Current M2 uses these inherited metal standards plus the ExoEOS dry-metal shifts. Kato1970 is an independent comparison, not the adopted metal-H standard.

comparison_molecular_H2.buffered_regressions: Existing hydrogen_reference.json remains the experimental reference; total buffered P is not H2 fugacity.

low_pressure_illustration.locator: Printed p15, pure-H2 illustration derived from basalt buffered slope with ideal gas mixing
low_pressure_illustration.role: Descriptive extrapolation, not directly measured low-pressure solubility or error bound

comparison_molecular_H2.Eq5_not_converted: The units implicit in ln(c/f) are not explicitly specified in Eq5/Fig9; no automatic mass-standard conversion from that expression is introduced.
comparison_molecular_H2.spectroscopic_systematic: New absorption calibration differs from the old coefficient by about an order of magnitude; no blanket rescaling of the adopted law.

comparison_atomic_H.supported_scope: Existing hydrogen_reference.py restricts pure Fe to 1843.15-2013.15K and FeSi joint fit to1843.15-1873.15K; reference p_H2=1atm; no O interactions.

uncertainty_policy: Retain measurement scatter, coefficient marginals and unknown covariance separately. Unknown composition, total-pressure and temperature-transfer uncertainties remain unbounded, never zero.
